hero.subtitle: SALES & CRM
hero.title: Win the next contract in the system you run the work in
hero.body: Find leads in the company register, keep every call on record, get notes from your meetings, send proposals you see opened, and have documents signed online.

sections.title: Find the companies you want to work for
sections.body: Search the company register and turn the results into leads, kept in lists with a priority and a status.

shot.what: Finding leads in the company register

sections.title: Who to call next, at a glance
sections.body: Lead lists with a priority for each, so the next call is always clear.

sections.title: Every call on record
sections.body: Every call is in the call log, beside the lead it belongs to. Before you call, an assistant can prepare a brief.

shot.what: Today's calls in the call log

sections.title: Listen, and get the notes afterwards
sections.body: Record a call or a meeting, with the other party's consent, and get a summary with the to-dos.

shot.what: Notes from a recorded meeting, with three to-dos

sections.title: Know when your proposal has been read
sections.body: Send the proposal as a link. The platform shows when the client opens it, so you call at the right moment.

shot.what: A proposal as the client sees it

sections.title: Documents signed online
sections.body: Send a document to be signed and follow its status in the platform.

shot.what: The signing status of a document

sections.title: Tenders you would otherwise miss
sections.body: Public tenders that fit your work are found for you, and an assistant analyses each one, so you can decide quickly whether to bid.

shot.what: A public tender with the assistant's analysis

items.a: Yes, with the other party's consent. The recording becomes notes on the lead.
Yes. Documents are signed online, and you see their status in the platform.

items.q: Which plans include the sales tools?

cta.title: See a proposal from both sides
cta.body: In the demo we show you the office view and the client's view. We reply within one working day.

hero.subtitle: SALG OG CRM
hero.title: Vind den næste aftale i det system, I driver arbejdet i
hero.body: Find leads i CVR-registret, hav hvert opkald registreret, få noter fra jeres møder, send tilbud, som I kan se er åbnet, og få dokumenter underskrevet online.

sections.title: Find de virksomheder, I vil arbejde for
sections.body: Søg i CVR-registret, og gør resultaterne til leads i lister med prioritet og status.

sections.title: Hvem I skal ringe til næste gang, med det samme
sections.body: Leadlister med en prioritet for hvert lead, så det næste opkald altid er klart.

sections.title: Hvert opkald registreret
sections.body: Hvert opkald står i opkaldsloggen ved det lead, det hører til. Før I ringer, kan en assistent forberede et kort overblik.

sections.title: Lyt, og få noterne bagefter
sections.body: Optag et opkald eller et møde med den andens samtykke, og få et resumé med opgaverne.

shot.what: Noter fra et optaget møde med tre opgaver

sections.title: Se, når jeres tilbud er læst
sections.body: Send tilbuddet som et link. Platformen viser, når kunden åbner det, så I ringer på det rigtige tidspunkt.

shot.what: Et tilbud, som kunden ser det

sections.title: Dokumenter underskrevet online
sections.body: Send et dokument til underskrift, og følg dets status i platformen.

shot.what: Status for et dokument til underskrift

sections.title: Udbud, I ellers ville gå glip af
sections.body: Offentlige udbud, der passer til jeres arbejde, bliver fundet for jer, og en assistent analyserer hvert enkelt, så I hurtigt kan beslutte, om I vil byde.

shot.what: Et offentligt udbud med assistentens analyse

items.a: Ja, med den andens samtykke. Optagelsen bliver til noter på leadet.
Ja. Dokumenter underskrives online, og I ser deres status i platformen.

cta.title: Se et tilbud fra begge sider
cta.body: I demoen viser vi både kontorets og kundens side. Vi svarer inden for 1 arbejdsdag.
